en_title: Blizzard Reveals Plan for World of Warcraft Forever Update Frequency
cn_title: 暴雪公布《魔兽世界Forever》更新计划
subtitle: 放慢脚步，分批解锁
opus_summary: 暴雪计划为《魔兽世界Forever》每四个月推出一次大型更新，并在期间逐步解锁内容，避免更新过快或长期断档。首次大型更新预计于2027年春季推出。

paragraphs.en: World of Warcraft Forever launches a week from today, and while the game will have a huge swath of content available on day one, there will be new content continually added to the game. But how frequently should fans expect new content to arrive? It sounds like Blizzard is willing to take things a little slower than in the modern version of World of Warcraft.
paragraphs.cn: 《魔兽世界Forever》将于一周后的今天上线。虽然上线首日就会提供大量内容，但之后游戏仍会持续加入新内容。那么，玩家可以期待多久更新一次？听起来，暴雪愿意把更新节奏放得比《魔兽世界》正式服稍慢一些。

paragraphs.en: In a recent interview with IGN , World of Warcraft Forever principal game designer Kris Zierhut, said Forever will employ a slower cadence than Midnight's aggressive 8-week content cycle: "we're fairly convinced the correct [update] rate is something closer to once every four months or 17 weeks or three times a year."
paragraphs.cn: 《魔兽世界Forever》首席游戏设计师Kris Zierhut近日接受IGN采访时表示，相比《至暗之夜》每8周更新一次的紧凑节奏，Forever的更新速度会更慢：「我们相当确信，合适的［更新］频率应该更接近每四个月一次，也就是每17周一次，或者每年三次。」

paragraphs.en: This is in contrast with the modern version of World of Warcraft, which has had an aggressive update cadence since Dragonflight launched in 2022. And while that approach has meant players of the modern version of the game have something new every couple of months, some have said the updates often feels rushed, with bugs and repeated content. We've all done some form of invasions several times in the last couple of years, after all.
paragraphs.cn: 这与《魔兽世界》正式服形成了对比。自2022年《巨龙时代》上线以来，正式服一直保持着紧凑的更新节奏。虽然这种做法让正式服玩家每隔几个月就有新内容可玩，但也有人表示，更新往往显得仓促，存在漏洞，内容也有重复。毕竟，过去几年里，我们都已经反复玩过好几次类似的入侵活动了。

paragraphs.en: Zierhut did say that Blizzard experimented with a faster update schedule in Season of Discovery, an experimental Classic game mode that came out in 2023, but "we cut it down to closer to that eight week or 10 week schedule. It felt way, way, way too fast."
paragraphs.cn: Zierhut确实提到，暴雪曾在2023年推出的实验性怀旧服模式「探索赛季」中尝试加快更新节奏，但「我们把更新间隔缩短到了接近8周或10周。感觉实在、实在、实在太快了。」

paragraphs.en: But by going with a four month update schedule, Forever will also avoid the content droughts that some older expansions were infamous for. There have been times in WoW's history where the game didn't have new content for a year at a time, like in Warlords of Draenor, where patch 6.2, which included Hellfire Citadel, lasted for 13 months before the prepatch update for Legion.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，采用每四个月更新一次的安排，也能让Forever避免陷入某些老资料片曾因之饱受诟病的内容空窗期。《魔兽世界》历史上曾出现过整整一年没有新内容的情况。比如在《德拉诺之王》期间，包含地狱火堡垒的6.2版本持续了13个月，才迎来《军团再临》的前夕更新。

paragraphs.en: Zierhut acknowledged this as well, saying: "We've played around with different rates of releasing content and going six or eight months without new stuff always feels bad. We know that."
paragraphs.cn: Zierhut也承认了这一点：「我们尝试过不同的内容发布节奏，六到八个月没有新内容，玩家的感受总是很糟糕。我们清楚这一点。」

paragraphs.en: But just because World of Warcraft patches will be released in four-month intervals, doesn't necessarily mean you'll have to wait four months for something new to do. Zierhut also told me that the team may timegate some content, saying "one nuance on that is we do plan on making content that unlocks in between. So you might have patches with major releases four months apart, but there may be things that unlock two or three months in or one month into that."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《魔兽世界》每隔四个月推出一次补丁，并不一定代表玩家要等上四个月才有新内容可玩。Zierhut还告诉我，团队可能会让部分内容按时间逐步开放。他说：「这里有个细节，我们确实计划制作一些在两次更新之间解锁的内容。所以，大型内容更新的补丁可能相隔四个月，但有些内容可能会在更新两三个月后，或一个月后解锁。」

paragraphs.en: The idea there is to ease players into content, rather than overwhelming them with everything all at once. Zierhut continued, saying: "It's not just patch day comes [around], here's a content fire hose, and now we're silent for four months. A lot of that is, hey, there's a time event calendar that gradually unlocks things and opens them up over those four months to give things a little bit more life instead of that all at once effect."
paragraphs.cn: 这样做是为了让玩家逐步体验内容，而不是一下子把所有内容都摆出来，让玩家应接不暇。Zierhut接着说：「我们不是等到补丁上线那天，一股脑地把内容全放出来，然后就沉默四个月。我们更多会通过活动日历，在这四个月里逐步解锁、开放内容，让这些内容更有活力，而不是一次性全部放出。」

paragraphs.en: Only time will tell if this middle ground between rapid updates and slow updates will pay off, but according to the roadmap that Blizzard released at BlizzCon, Forever will have its first major update sometime in spring 2027. So, if that four-month timeline that Blizzard is targeting pays off, WoW Forever should have a fresh round of new content sometime in March.
paragraphs.cn: 在快速更新与缓慢更新之间采取这种折中方案，能否奏效还需要时间检验。不过，根据暴雪在暴雪嘉年华上公布的路线图，《魔兽世界Forever》将在2027年春季迎来首次大型更新。因此，如果暴雪能按计划实现四个月的更新间隔，《魔兽世界Forever》应该会在3月迎来一批新内容。

paragraphs.en: While you wait for the game to launch, check out more on Blizzard's plan for World of Warcraft Forever .
paragraphs.cn: 在等待游戏上线期间，不妨进一步了解暴雪对《魔兽世界Forever》的规划。
